Owned and operated by Colin Comer, we provide services that meet both commercial and residential needs. Our landscaping services include commercial grounds maintenance, residential lawn care, installation of sod, mulch, and gravel, hardscaping, irrigation installation and repair, landscape design and lighting, and erosion control.

ab-p2.paragraph: When it comes to quality work, we are the first you should call.

sv-hd-ld.paragraph: Seven services, year-round, for homes and commercial sites across the Columbia area.

sv0-p.paragraph: Scheduled mowing, edging, beds and seasonal cleanups that keep a business looking cared for.

sv1-p.paragraph: Regular mowing, trimming and clean edges, so the yard is ready whenever you are.

sv2-p.paragraph: Sod, mulch, gravel and decorative rock installed for clean, low-upkeep beds and borders.

sv3-p.paragraph: Patios, walkways, walls and steps that give the yard structure and a place to gather.

sv4-p.paragraph: New systems put in and existing ones repaired, so the lawn gets water where it needs it.

sv5-p.paragraph: Planting plans and low-voltage lighting that make the property work after dark too.

sv6-p.paragraph: Grading, walls, stone and groundcover to hold a slope and move water where it should go.

pr-hd-h.title: Three words in the logo. One plan for your yard.

pr0-p.paragraph: Tell us what you have in mind. We look at the site and lay out a plan and a quote.

pr1-p.paragraph: Grading, drainage, sod, rock, hardscape and irrigation, installed by the same company that planned it.

pr2-p.paragraph: Reliable, year-round care for lawns and commercial grounds, so the work keeps its shape.

rs-hd-ld.paragraph: Three jobs from Comer’s own photos, from the first pass to the result.

rs0-p.paragraph: Hydroseed goes down, then the bank holds.

rs1-p.paragraph: A washed-out crossing, then pipe and stone.

rs2-p.paragraph: Graded to bare soil, then a lawn that is kept.

eq-hd-ld.paragraph: From residential beds to roadside right-of-way, the work calls for more than a push mower.

eq0-p.paragraph: Comer’s flatbed hauls a tracked skid steer from job to job.

eq1-p.paragraph: A tracked skid steer for grading, loading and attachments.

eq2-p.paragraph: A mowing attachment for overgrown fields and highway right-of-way.

eq3-p.paragraph: For drainage pipe, culverts and cutting an access path.
